items.title: Implement shared signed workspace resolver and story_resolve surface
items.context: Add a shared resolver that separates metadataRoot, signedWorkspaceRoot, authoritativeCwd, worktreePath, resolutionSource, and unresolvedReason. story_resolve must not present a non-git wrapper root as executable REVIEW cwd when signed workspace is unresolved.
items.userSees: User sees story_resolve JSON include metadataRoot, signedWorkspaceRoot, authoritativeCwd, resolved, resolutionSource, and unresolvedReason; non-git wrapper roots no longer appear as executable REVIEW cwd.

happy.desc: story_resolve for an ordinary git-backed REVIEW story reports resolved=true and a signedWorkspaceRoot rooted in the git worktree.

edge.desc: story_resolve for a non-git metadataRoot with no worktree/gitRoot reports resolved=false, signedWorkspaceRoot=null, authoritativeCwd=null, and an unresolvedReason instead of returning the wrapper root as executable cwd.

adversarial.desc: story_resolve does not auto-select a nested git repository merely because one exists below metadataRoot.

items.title: Bind review_run_start and REVIEW evidence consumers to resolved signed workspace
items.context: Use the resolver for review_run_start snapshot capture and scope binding, preserve metadata writes through metadataRoot, fail closed for unresolved wrapper-root cases, and add/preserve signed workspaceBinding/process-fact consistency as needed.

items.title: Add regression coverage for split-root and Authority-boundary cases
items.context: Cover normal git roots, non-git wrapper roots, explicit gitRoot, linked worktrees, no HEAD/materialHash, stale or tampered workspace binding, and Authority overclaim prevention without requiring a real Authority Server.

items.title: Implement explicit gitRoot signed workspace binding path
items.context: Add a concrete operator repair path for wrapper-root projects by supporting an explicit gitRoot configuration that resolves metadataRoot/gitRoot as the signedWorkspaceRoot after validating it is a git repository with HEAD/materialHash. This closes the ClawCreek issue beyond diagnostics while avoiding arbitrary nested repo guessing.
